text:

author: Sarah S

title: Exciting show in an extraordinary palace
text: I attended this Grand Gala of Flamenco in the magnificent Palau de la Musica Catalana and I came out excited. The place is magical and fascinating, the dancers and musicians are of exceptional skill and elegance. Time flies watching them! Too bad you can't take photos or videos during the show, but maybe it's for the best, otherwise we would have had the view blocked by other people's phones (although in some reviews I saw photos taken by surprise). It's not the first flamenco show I've seen, but it's definitely -thanks to the location- the most exciting.
author: StefiRome

title: Go To Barcelona
text: Barcelona is spectacular & beautiful. The people and the food are wonderful. The sights! The landscapes! The history! Everywhere we went, people were very nice & welcoming. I have a new favorite country and can not wait to return.

title: Beautiful
